comment: One of the greatest professors I have ever had in college. He is a very smart man and did a very good job of explaining admittedly complex concepts. I was saddened to learn that he has left UR for a position at VMI. He will be missed.
Inspired me to change my major from economics to political science through his passion of the subject and the rigor of work. Life changing teacher.

Bakich's passion for political science shines through in every lecture. The readings are long and sometimes dense, but they add to the course. The papers are fair and there's only two of them, so the course is a little back-loaded. Show up, read the articles ahead of time, and be ready to study the causal charts and you'll do fine and learn a ton.
Genus.  Too genius for his students though.  Talks like he's memorized the thesaurus... twice.
